description: List TLS certificates whose subject organization matches a name, e.g. "PayPal, Inc.": id, subject common name, domains, issuer and validity dates. Covers certificates valid now or expired within the last 90 days unless archive is set to "full" or a year from 2013 (needs an API key on the Pro plan). One call counts as 10 requests against the rate limit.

archive.description: "full" for all certificates since 2013, or a four-digit year from 2013 for certificates valid into that year or later; needs an API key on the Pro plan. Omit for certificates valid now or expired within the last 90 days

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous call, to get the next page; omit for the first page

name.description: Organization name as it appears in the certificate subject, e.g. "PayPal, Inc."

name: search_organization
title: Search certificates by organization
